description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.50 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +20000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Ysayle)] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Ysayle)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Glacial Power after casting Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Ysayle)] to the user
